picks.title: As It Is
picks.highlight: 流行朋克劲旅新专辑，能量满满，不可错过！
picks.highlightEn: Pop punk powerhouse delivers an energetic new album not to be missed!
picks.summary: As It Is 是知名流行朋克乐队，新作保持高水准，旋律抓耳，适合现场蹦迪。
picks.summaryEn: As It Is is a well-known pop punk band; new album maintains high quality with catchy melodies, perfect for mosh pits.

picks.title: Uprising
picks.highlight: 雷鬼传奇经典重版，牙买加之声永流传。
picks.highlightEn: Reggae legend reissued, the sound of Jamaica forever.
picks.summary: Bob Marley 是全球雷鬼音乐代表，这张专辑收录经典曲目，节奏舒缓，充满自由精神。
picks.summaryEn: Bob Marley is the global icon of reggae; this album features classic tracks with laid-back rhythms and a spirit of freedom.

picks.title: The Stooges
picks.highlight: 原型朋克始祖首专，狂野不羁，影响无数。
picks.highlightEn: The debut proto-punk masterpiece, wild and unrestrained, influencing countless bands.
picks.summary: The Stooges 这张同名专辑是摇滚史里程碑，Iggy Pop 的嘶吼和原始吉他 riff 定义了朋克精神。
picks.summaryEn: The Stooges' self-titled album is a milestone in rock history; Iggy Pop's howls and raw guitar riffs defined punk attitude.

picks.title: The Shieling – Companion Pieces
picks.highlight: 苏格兰爵士钢琴家感性EP，宁静而深邃。
picks.highlightEn: Scottish jazz pianist's emotive EP, serene and profound.
picks.summary: Fergus McCreadie 融合爵士与凯尔特民谣，钢琴技巧精湛，氛围宁静治愈。
picks.summaryEn: Fergus McCreadie blends jazz with Celtic folk; exquisite piano technique, calm and healing atmosphere.

picks.title: Leather Temple
picks.highlight: 法国电子摇滚重磅回归，合成器轰鸣，暗黑动感。
picks.highlightEn: French electronic rock returns with roaring synths, dark and dynamic.
picks.summary: Carpenter Brut 以复古合成器和重吉他著称，新专辑延续电影感声音，适合夜店和游戏。
picks.summaryEn: Carpenter Brut is known for vintage synths and heavy guitars; new album continues cinematic sound, perfect for clubs and games.

picks.title: The Power Station
picks.highlight: 80年代超级组合唯一专辑，流行摇滚经典。
picks.highlightEn: The sole album from the 80s supergroup, a pop rock classic.
picks.summary: The Power Station 由 Duran Duran 成员组成，融合放克与摇滚，节奏强劲，是80年代标志性声音。
picks.summaryEn: The Power Station, formed by Duran Duran members, blends funk and rock with powerful grooves; an iconic 80s sound.

picks.title: RAVEPOP
picks.artist: r u s s e l b u c k
picks.highlight: 狂躁快乐硬核，电子舞曲的疯狂实验。
picks.highlightEn: Frantic happy hardcore, a wild experiment in electronic dance music.
picks.summary: r u s s e l b u c k 融合快乐硬核、donk 等多种风格，节奏疯狂，适合派对现场。
picks.summaryEn: r u s s e l b u c k fuses happy hardcore, donk, and more; frantic beats, perfect for party raves.

picks.title: Snow, Vol. 9
picks.highlight: Lo-fi 制作人冬日续篇，轻快 chill 节奏。
picks.highlightEn: Lo-fi producer's winter sequel, upbeat chill beats.
picks.summary: Wun Two 是 lo-fi hip hop 领域热门人物，新 EP 带来温暖采样和轻松鼓点，适合放松。
picks.summaryEn: Wun Two is a prominent lo-fi hip hop artist; new EP offers warm samples and laid-back drums, perfect for relaxation.

picks.title: Monument
picks.highlight: 德国哥特金属军团新作，阴郁与暴力并存。
picks.highlightEn: German gothic metal legion's new album, merging gloom and aggression.
picks.summary: Crematory 是哥特金属代表，新专辑融合工业元素，旋律沉重，适合金属爱好者。
picks.summaryEn: Crematory is a gothic metal staple; new album incorporates industrial elements, heavy melodies for metal fans.

picks.title: Masekela
picks.highlight: 南非爵士号手传奇录音，非洲节奏与爵士完美交融。
picks.highlightEn: Legendary South African trumpeter's recordings, perfect fusion of African rhythms and jazz.
picks.summary: Hugh Masekela 是南非爵士巨匠，音乐充满非洲律动和抗议精神，小号声感人至深。
picks.summaryEn: Hugh Masekela is a South African jazz giant; music filled with African grooves and protest spirit, trumpet deeply moving.

picks.title: The Great Adventure
picks.highlight: 瑞士舞曲天王全新专辑，欧陆舞池热单制造机。
picks.highlightEn: Swiss dance music king's new album, Eurodance hitmaker.
picks.summary: DJ BoBo 是90年代欧陆舞曲代表，新作依然 upbeat，旋律洗脑，适合跳舞。
picks.summaryEn: DJ BoBo is a 90s Eurodance icon; new album remains upbeat with catchy melodies, perfect for dancing.

picks.title: Big Cock
picks.highlight: 英国 Psychobilly 乐队恶搞专辑，疯狂复古摇滚。
picks.highlightEn: UK psychobilly band's absurd album, wild retro rock.
picks.summary: King Kurt 以幽默和疯狂舞台著称，音乐融合摇滚和朋克，吉他声浪劲爆。
picks.summaryEn: King Kurt is known for humor and wild shows; music blends rockabilly and punk, explosive guitar sound.

picks.title: snowfall
picks.highlight: 梦幻电子氛围专辑，雪落无声，心静如水。
picks.highlightEn: Dreamy electronic ambient album, silent snowfall, serene mind.
picks.summary: wüsh 以细腻的电子音景营造宁静雪境，旋律优美，适合独自聆听。
picks.summaryEn: wüsh creates a tranquil snowy landscape with delicate electronic soundscapes; beautiful melodies, perfect for solitary listening.

picks.title: Nothing Hurts Like Everything
picks.highlight: 加拿大独立摇滚新声，情感细腻，旋律动听。
picks.highlightEn: Canadian indie rock newcomer, emotionally nuanced with lovely melodies.
picks.summary: Ourson 的专辑展现独立摇滚的温柔一面，吉他编曲精致，人声温暖。
picks.summaryEn: Ourson's album shows the gentle side of indie rock; delicate guitar arrangements, warm vocals.

picks.title: Von Abseits
picks.highlight: 德语嘻哈地下之声，街头故事与押韵技巧。
picks.highlightEn: German underground hip hop, street stories and lyrical skills.
picks.summary: Doppelkopf 是德语嘻哈代表，歌词犀利，flow 流畅，展现德国街头文化。
picks.summaryEn: Doppelkopf represents German hip hop with sharp lyrics and smooth flow, showcasing German street culture.

picks.title: Appalachia
picks.highlight: 阿巴拉契亚民谣，美国乡村故事的低语。
picks.highlightEn: Appalachian folk, whispers of American rural stories.
picks.summary: Emily Scott Robinson 以细腻叙事和优美吉他，讲述阿巴拉契亚山区生活，情感真挚。
picks.summaryEn: Emily Scott Robinson tells stories of Appalachian life with delicate narrative and beautiful guitar, genuine emotion.

picks.title: The Lighthouse Session II
picks.highlight: 丹麦厄运金属现场EP，沉重而唯美。
picks.highlightEn: Danish doom metal live EP, heavy yet beautiful.
picks.summary: Saturnus 是厄运金属代表，新EP收录现场演绎，氛围悲凉，旋律动人。
picks.summaryEn: Saturnus is a doom metal staple; new EP features live renditions, melancholic atmosphere, moving melodies.

picks.title: Unity
picks.highlight: 荷兰激流金属与回响贝斯跨界，暴躁实验。
picks.highlightEn: Dutch thrash metal meets dubstep, aggressive experimentation.
picks.summary: Pariah 大胆融合激流金属和电子元素，节奏凶猛，充满张力。
picks.summaryEn: Pariah boldly fuses thrash metal and electronic elements; fierce rhythms, full of tension.
